fullPassage: Critics sometimes worry that by making it easier for small parties to win seats, proportional representation will encourage the growth of extremist groups standing on hateful or anti-democratic platforms. Of course, no one committed to liberal and democratic values wants to see these kinds of parties taking seats in the legislature. But it would be wrong to rig our political system to exclude them just because we disagree with their views. Proportional voting systems provide a democratic vent for populist anger and discontent, creating clear incentives for mainstream parties to address underlying social problems and to win back votes. We also have to remember that small parties can play a value role in highlighting specific issues that have been overlooked, as has often been the case with 'Green' parties. In any case, the European experience suggests that there is no overall tendency for extremist parties to increase their numbers over time under proportional systems. Role-playing is an extension of representational skills. Children role-play when they use not only materials and objects but also voice and actions to represent others during play. Infants and toddlers begin to play a role when they imitate adults' language, dress, or actions. An older child expands on this role by imitating familiar roles, such as a parent or doctor. The child uses gestures and language to communicate his understanding of what this role represents. He uses the doctor kit or kitchen playthings as props to support his actions while he plays. For instance, he may use a cylinder-shaped block as a syringe when pretending to be a doctor. As he becomes familiar with other people and their roles, he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter. Playing fantasy characters, such as a monster or a superhero, becomes common once a child is able to engage in more abstract thinking. People are inherently social creatures, and in order to connect and regulate their social interactions, they must internalize their cultures. But cultures cannot be internalized without language. Indeed, language is the vehicle through which we learn about our social world, discover its rules and values, and express our personal natures, allowing us to connect with others, both in relationships of exchange and of caring. Cultures themselves interact. As far back as the origins of human history, groups of individuals sharing a common culture and language made contact with other groups, each unified by their own shared tongue. Of great value was anyone who could ably facilitate those intergroup contacts — those people who were multilingual. Today we humans exist in a globally interconnected world. We can transact with people from anywhere in seconds through the internet, or visit them through rapid means of travel, and in doing so experience a bit of their cultures. To make art and design irresistible, the teacher must commit to providing opportunities that incite feelings of surprise and, thus motivational discovery and learning. This teaching approach is exciting — it allows the practitioner to consider what is tempting in learning, what drives an individual to find out and discover. The teacher needs to remember what it is about learning that makes it irresistible, and then design their lessons, their spaces of learning and their teaching materials accordingly. This is not teaching that rigidly conforms to an instructional, target-bound paradigm. It is essential to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are operating and finding out. Classrooms of young children should be alive, dynamic and changeable, encouraged by a theme of the moment or an interest that pervades children's imaginations.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 exclude와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 rigidly와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

❌ ① strictly(엄격하게)는 rigidly와 유사한 의미이다.
❌ ② firmly(단단히)는 rigidly와 유사한 뉘앙스이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 engage의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 아이가 추상적 사고에 참여할 수 있게 되면 (B) 아이들의 상상력을 사로잡는
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)의 '고용하다'는 추상적 사고와 어울리지 않으며, (B)의 '참여하다'는 상상력을 사로잡는다는 뜻과 다르다.
✅ ② (A)의 engage는 '추상적 사고에 참여하다', (B)의 engage는 '상상력을 사로잡다'로 가장 적절하다. ←정답
❌ ③ (A)의 '약속하다'와 (B)의 '맞물리다'는 모두 이 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
❌ ④ (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀌어 있다.
det.tip: engage in = ~에 참여하다/종사하다. engage someone's attention/imagination = ~의 관심/상상력을 사로잡다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to make something part of your own thinking or behavior by learning or experiencing it"

det.korean: 학습이나 경험을 통해 자신의 사고나 행동의 일부로 만들다
det.analysis:
❌ ① externalize(외면화하다)는 내면의 것을 밖으로 표현하는 것으로 반대 방향이다.
❌ ② materialize(실현되다)는 '구체화되다'라는 뜻으로 전혀 다르다.
❌ ③ memorize(암기하다)는 단순히 기억하는 것이지 자기 것으로 내면화하는 것과 다르다.
✅ ④ internalize(내면화하다)는 '배우거나 경험하여 자기 것으로 만들다'라는 정의에 정확히 맞는다. ←정답
det.tip: internalize = internal(내부의) + -ize(~화하다) = 내면화하다. 문화를 내면화(internalize)해야 사회적 상호작용을 조절할 수 있다.

questions.passage: Of course, no one __________ (commit) to liberal and democratic values wants to see these kinds of parties taking seats in the legislature. But it would be wrong to rig our political system to exclude them just because we disagree with their views.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 자유주의적이고 민주적인 가치에 헌신하는 사람은 아무도 이런 정당이 의회에서 의석을 차지하는 것을 보고 싶어 하지 않는다.
det.analysis: commit(동사: 헌신하다)을 과거분사 committed로 바꿔야 한다. 'no one committed to ~'에서 committed는 과거분사로서 no one을 수식하는 분사구문이다. 'be committed to ~'(~에 헌신하다)의 수식 형태.
det.tip: be committed to = ~에 헌신하다/전념하다. 분사가 명사를 뒤에서 수식하는 후치수식 구문.

questions.passage: Today we humans exist in a globally __________ (interconnect) world. We can transact with people from anywhere in seconds through the internet, or visit them through rapid means of travel, and in doing so experience a bit of their cultures.

det.korean: 오늘날 우리 인간은 전 세계적으로 상호 연결된 세계에 살고 있다.

det.tip: interconnected = inter(상호) + connected(연결된). 과거분사가 명사를 수식하는 형용사 역할.

det.korean: 창의적인 두뇌가 작동할 때 천장이 없는 교실을 제공하는 것이 필수적이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① no doubt(의심 없이)는 '의심할 여지 없이'라는 부사구로 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
❌ ② no choice(선택의 여지 없는)는 전혀 다른 의미이다.
✅ ③ no ceiling(천장 없는)은 창의적 두뇌가 작동할 때 한계가 없어야 한다는 원문의 비유에 정확히 맞는다. ←정답
❌ ④ no limit(제한 없는)은 의미상 유사하나 원문의 정확한 표현은 ceiling이다.
det.tip: no ceiling = 천장이 없다 (비유: 한계가 없다). 교실에서 창의성이 자유롭게 발휘될 수 있어야 한다는 의미.
